title: Add semantics/tooltip to the icon-only close and back buttons in step_starting_position.dart and track_management_body.dart
why: Both IconButtons carry no `tooltip` (nor an explicit Semantics label), unlike every other icon-only button in this batch (scope_tiles.dart, scope_views.dart, curriculum_picker_step.dart all set tooltip). A screen-reader user hits an unlabeled 'button' for the selection-clear action and for the track-management screen's primary back action.
recommendation: Add tooltip: l10n.<key> to both, mirroring the pattern already used for the other IconButtons in the same files.
acceptance_criteria: Both IconButtons have a non-null, localized tooltip.
A semantics test (find.bySemanticsLabel or similar) locates each button by its new label.
